# AI Video & Image Generator by Clipwave

Create AI images and videos from a text prompt: review model, ratio, resolution and duration in a panel, then render in your ManyMotions account.

## What it does

Describe an image or a video. Claude prepares a Media Forge project in an interactive panel where you choose the model, aspect ratio, resolution and duration and see the credits required. When you confirm, it generates the image or video with an AI model in your ManyMotions account and returns the media link.

**AI generation:** the media are generated by AI models run by ManyMotions and its model providers. Nothing is generated until you ask for it, and the credits required are shown first.

Text-to-image and text-to-video only. Uploaded or reference media, image editing and video-to-video are not supported.

## Setup

The plugin connects Claude to the ManyMotions MCP server at `https://manymotions.com/api/claude/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).

- Preparing a request is free and works without an account.
- The first render asks you to sign in to ManyMotions (OAuth with PKCE; you can create an account on the same page). Rendering needs verified paid access and available credits on the account.
- Claude shows an interactive panel where the client supports MCP Apps; Claude Code works with text and links.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `prepare_media_forge_project` | Prepare a project and show the panel. Free, no sign-in. |
| `render_media_forge_widget` | Reopen a prepared project in the panel. |
| `generate_media_forge` | Render the image or video. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_media_forge_job` | Check a render and return the media link. Read-only. |

## Example prompts

- "Make a 5-second cinematic video of a red fox running through fresh snow at dawn"
- "Generate a photorealistic product image of a ceramic mug on a wooden table, soft studio light"
- "Create a vertical 9:16 video of ocean waves at sunset for an Instagram Reel"

## Data and privacy

Your prompts and settings are sent to ManyMotions and stored in your ManyMotions account, and they are sent to the model providers that render the media. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.

- Privacy policy: https://manymotions.com/privacy
- Terms of service: https://manymotions.com/terms
- Documentation: https://manymotions.com/mcp#video-image-maker
- Support: https://manymotions.com/support

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
